full_judgment: 2. The relevant facts, for the disposal of this petition, in short, are that the writ respondent No.1 issued a tender notice to sell 3.95 acres of land of plot No. 1593 and 1578 of Khatian No.12 under Mouza-Godnail, Police Station -Siddhirgonj, District -Narayangonj commonly known of Godnail, Press House Angon" (hereinafter referred as ----"disputed property"). The writ petitioner on 03.08.2011 filed application addressing the respondent No.1 expressing his intention to purchase the said land offering 2% additional price on the valuation assessed by the Divisional Commissioner on 10.05.2001. The writ respondent No.3 issued a letter on 18.08.2011 to the writ respondent No.2 requesting him to submit a report on the basis of the application. The writ respondent No.1 issued a letter on 29.11.2011 to the writ petitioner stating that the value of the disputed has been assessed at tk. 2,36,56,650.75/- which was 50% enhanced rate than that of earlier assessed amount. The writ petitioner, accordingly, paid 25% of the said amount and promised to deposit the rest 75% taka within 90 days. The writ petitioner, getting letter of intent on 29.11.2011, deposited the rest amount and also paid income tax of Tk,11,83,000/-. One Abu Jafar Ahmed and Nekot Ali filed two separate writ petitions and obtained Rules against the process of sale which were discharged, Thereafter, the respondent No.1 issued impugned letter dated 17.01.2013 stating that though a letter of intent was issued to the writ petitioner on 29.11.2011 to sell the disputed property at consideration of Tk. 2,36,56,656.75/- but such valuation is shocking low and that the present market price of the same is Tk. 38,32,74,245.97/- and, thereby, cancelled the earlier letter of intent.
